description: Read the saved page dependency inventory with HTML/browser evidence. Existing paid page-watch passes add continuing source checks and change alerts. Joining page markup, browser network results, domain registration and DNS observations, then keeping their change history. Browser evidence covers its page load. Source gaps remain unknown. Domain expiry and NXDOMAIN do not prove takeover. Task-token savings have not been measured.
